svg.title: Forward hysteresis in an NPZD model
svg.desc: Equilibrium phytoplankton level of the rescaled nutrient-phytoplankton-zooplankton-detritus (NPZD) model of Macdonald and Gulbudak (2023) against the maximum harmful effect of phytoplankton on zooplankton, with parameters from the paper's table and bifurcation-figure caption. Above a value near 2.4, where the paper's zooplankton persistence number equals one, the zooplankton-free equilibrium is locally stable and no coexistence equilibrium exists. Below it a coexistence branch bifurcates forward and folds twice, so between about 1.68 and 2.03 two stable coexistence states exist with an unstable state between them. Stable branches are solid; unstable branches are dashed or dotted. Values are recomputed from the model equations, not copied from the paper.
svg.title: Forward hysteresis in an NPZD model
